angleRead.name: Trevor Shimizu
angleRead.text: I’m looking into the dip in ridership at Lake Merritt station, which saw the steepest decline this cycle—down 2,588 riders compared to C109. Fog and events in Lake Merritt and Chinatown seem to be factors, but I want to dig deeper. Who’s feeling the impact? Are transit workers noticing changes in their routines or interactions with riders? I’ll start by talking to the transit operators and mechanics on the roster to see if they’ve observed anything unusual or if there’s more to the story than just weather and events.
